milestones.name: M0 - Reference and package contract
milestones.exit: The v5 reference is reproducible, all 42 behaviors are inventoried, and a portable candidate package validates.

milestones.name: M1 - Complete local pilot
milestones.exit: Import, preview, activation, overview, chronology and original-document navigation work locally before fan-out.

milestones.name: M2 - Full v5 local parity
milestones.exit: All 42 views, user work, exports, offline operation and acceptance evidence pass.

milestones.name: M3 - Newer export and manual authoring
milestones.exit: The 2,131-document export and one structured Markdown authoring round trip pass without v5 regressions.

linear.name: M3 - Newer export and manual authoring

milestones.name: M4 - Hosted readiness decisions
milestones.exit: Operator-contract evidence is recorded and client isolation, roles, durable storage and hosting are resolved.

milestones.name: M6 - Future processing automation
milestones.exit: Deferred Pi Durable design and implementation preserve human publication approval.

items.title: Freeze the v5 fixture and behavior baseline
items.outcome: A new worker can reproduce the sample inventory and identify every expected behavior without relying on chat history.
acceptance: Read the original archive without modifying it. Fingerprint the archive and main HTML; record the build date and exactly 1,689 chronology records and 42 navigation entries.
Produce a local reference-to-path inventory, duplicate and missing-file reports, and a per-view action/export/state checklist. Keep case documents and extracted text outside Git.
Record literal expected examples for filters, citations, calculations and mutable workflows. Fix the clock for date-sensitive examples. Classify source defects separately from rewrite defects.
Document a fresh-machine setup and a local fixture location. Capture representative v5 screens safely with networking disabled; no execution of archive processing scripts.

Record each view's data sources and distinguish imported datasets from user-work stores in docs/reference/view-checklist.md. Propose view-coverage changes for the coordinator; before M2 dispatch, the coordinator resolves consumer dependencies for Invoice Ledger, Conflict Check, Court Bundle and CaseLines from this evidence.

Create `docs/reference/audit-dispositions.md` from the BA-01 to BA-21 disposition table in the delivery plan. Record each finding's owner, applicable fixture/view, correction or disclosure, explicit deferral and evidence requirement. A deferred source repair must not be reported as fixed.

Map the 42 v5 navigation entries against the production audit's 55 routes without equating the counts. Identify production-only capabilities as V2-owned or explicitly deferred, and list any newer-export dataset that remains unsupported. Browser-agent product behavior is deferred; no browser agent is implied by local parity.

Capture a citation and its original file

items.performanceBudget: Record the first baseline. Fail a repeat above 1.25 times the median baseline on the same unchanged fixture.

items.title: Validate and convert a portable results package
items.outcome: An operator can convert the v5 sample to an inspectable package and obtain actionable validation errors before activation.
acceptance: Specify and implement the v5 adapter with case identity, input revision, results version, manifest, datasets, originals and attachment relationships. Do not execute imported HTML to obtain data.

Validate all dataset shapes and refs, path containment, duplicate IDs, unsupported versions and ambiguous asset mappings. Use distinct diagnostics for known baseline defects and new structural failures.
Preserve source values and provenance. Use file fingerprints for asset identity; do not equate legacy refs across independently rebuilt packs.

Import produces an immutable candidate and diagnostics. Repeated conversion is deterministic. User notes and registers are not embedded in immutable results. Define the generated-data versus authored-analysis boundary.
Establish the minimal Bun/TypeScript/Vitest toolchain and Bun check, test and measure scripts needed to execute this ticket. CC-03 extends these files only after the package gate passes.

Treat every imported narrative, filename, URL and metadata field as untrusted content, not only manually authored Markdown. Reject unsafe link schemes and define safe rendering rules in the package contract. Verify hostile fixtures cannot execute code.

Define bounded file, record and nesting sizes; if archive extraction is supported, bound expanded size and reject traversal/symlink escapes and malformed archives. Invalid or excessive inputs must fail with actionable diagnostics before activation.

items.performanceBudget: Set numeric conversion and memory limits from the CC-01 baseline before implementation. Repeat imports must stay within 1.25 times the accepted median.

items.title: Complete the local import to original-document workflow
items.outcome: The operator imports a candidate, previews and activates it, then follows a chronology citation to the correct original.
acceptance: Choose and pin the local stack after comparing the minimum viable storage choices. Use the recommended SvelteKit and TypeScript unless a measured constraint justifies a change.

Implement case-folder selection, validation report, candidate preview, activation, overview, chronology and document detail. Open or download supported original types with explicit unsupported/missing states.
Keep the active version unchanged on failed import. Keep originals outside Git. Serve only loopback and work with outbound networking disabled.
Provide history-aware navigation, accessible focus, case-aware titles, citation links and a reproducible boot/verification command. This complete workflow is the pilot before feature fan-out.

Freeze navigation entries and route extension points for all 42 views using the coordinator-owned view inventory. Reserve one feature subtree per worker and define shared component/persistence contracts before fan-out. Unimplemented entries remain explicitly unavailable until their owning issue passes. The coordinator serializes dependency, lockfile, shared layout and configuration changes during M2.

Ownership transfer after CC-02 is accepted. Extend package.json, bun.lock, tsconfig.json, vitest.config.* serially, preserving the accepted behavior and documentation. The previous owner is no longer an active writer on these paths.

Apply the package's safe-rendering and link policy throughout overview, chronology, document details and previews. Active original content must not execute with the application's origin/privileges; isolate supported previews or offer an explicit download. Test hostile narratives, filenames, links and original files without outbound access.

For dates used in chronology, retain the source value and expose supplied date type/provenance or explicitly mark the basis unknown. Do not silently infer a document issue date from an incidental date. Source metadata re-extraction is deferred (BA-04).
Navigation names must match their destinations and use task names rather than development-priority labels (BA-18).

Address audit findings BA-09 (distinguish a direct original, the parent-email route and an unavailable source), BA-14 (navigation semantics match keyboard behaviour; focus and browser Back work) and BA-16 (case-, section- and document-aware titles and history entries), as docs/reference/audit-dispositions.md assigns them.

items.outcome: A reviewer can find a document through filters or search, inspect its people/entities and agreements, and compare available text.
acceptance: Cover Documents, Contracts, Filings & Affidavits, Advanced Search, People, Entities and Document Diff with their recorded actions.
Preserve query/filter/sort/page state through navigation and exports. Distinguish invalid ranges from genuine empty results.
Disclose indexed-text limits and unsupported files. Do not label a truncated corpus search as full-document search.
Use literal expected search/diff examples and justified comparison relationships. Keep original links and filing-register edits functional.

Treat imported filing classifications and inferred professional identities as unverified unless supported by review evidence; disclose that status and test the audit's misleading classification/automated-sender cases. Do not present an automated sender as a verified attorney. Preserve raw source data; full extraction/classification rebuild remains deferred (BA-05, BA-07).
Ensure document ordering labels, active sort, pagination and exported order agree (BA-17).

Address the audit findings that docs/reference/audit-dispositions.md assigns here. Require a justified version relationship or an explicitly user-selected pair for document comparison and disclose the compared text coverage (BA-06). Disclose truncated or absent text and what search and comparison cover, with counts derived from the rows rather than summary metadata (BA-08). Reject a reversed date interval distinctly from a genuine empty result (BA-15).

items.title: Rescan local files and restore user work safely
items.outcome: An operator discovers changed files, queues manual reprocessing and can restore all local work without corrupting the active case.
acceptance: Cover Rescan & Update, Backup / Restore and Manual.
A repeat scan is idempotent. Detect additions, removals and changed contents; do not assign duplicate refs or claim analysis is current after a shallow rescan.
Backup includes user-entered state and required identities/version metadata. State clearly whether binaries are included. Validate restore and scope it to the correct case.
Corrupt or incompatible backups leave active data unchanged. Verify restoration into a fresh local profile and document startup, import, search coverage and backup behavior.

Own and record backup/restore time and memory budgets before implementing this workflow, then measure them on the accepted fixture. [GRS-17](https://linear.app/vaper/issue/GRS-17/maintain-case-registers-without-losing-edits) completion requires its own register read/write evidence and does not wait for these later measurements.

Backup and restore operate generically over CC-03's user-work persistence contract and cover every user-work table that contract holds, including tables that later M2 tickets add. The coverage checklist is the app's persisted equivalent of each live user-work store in the store table of docs/reference/view-checklist.md. These are ess_dcs_annotations_v1, ess_dcs_authorities_v1, ess_dcs_bundle_header_v2, ess_dcs_caselines_docs_v1, ess_dcs_crossexam_v1, ess_dcs_custom_bundles_v1, ess_dcs_deadlines_v1, ess_dcs_disbursements_v1, ess_dcs_enf_status_v1, ess_dcs_filings_v1, ess_dcs_heads_v1, ess_dcs_info_done_v1, ess_dcs_payments_v1, ess_dcs_popia_v1, ess_dcs_privilege_v1, ess_dcs_rescan_v1, ess_dcs_schedule_co_v1, ess_dcs_schedule_mode_v1, ess_dcs_schedule_sel_v1, ess_dcs_timesheet_v1 and ess_dcs_transcripts_v1. This includes the bundle header, the CaseLines documents and the three discovery-schedule stores that v5's own backup omits (S-backup_tab-1).
Rescan publishes its rows through CC-03's document-row read contract, so readers need no dependency on CC-10.
Wire the overview's rescan freshness stamp through the overview extension point that CC-03 provides, from CC-10's own subtree.
Keep a documented, tested extension point for importing v5 browser-stored work (backup files, including the four legacy keys) later; the import itself is not part of V1.

Check keyboard/focus, Back, labels, contrast and layouts at 320, 390, 768 and 1280 pixels. Provide screenshots and a short walkthrough.

Record interleaved comparable reference/head metrics and absolute local budgets. Independently review known-data defects and corrections. Request user visual review at the concrete merge-ready result; do not merge or publish under this planning task.

A second reviewer from a different supported model family reviews the acceptance suite, verification scripts and documentation written by this gate owner, then independently reruns critical paths at the exact integrated revision. The author cannot issue their own final PASS.
Ownership transfer after CC-03 is accepted. Extend docs/development.md serially, preserving the accepted behavior and documentation. The previous owner is no longer an active writer on these paths.
Ownership transfer after CC-10 is accepted. Extend docs/user-guide.md serially, preserving the accepted behavior and documentation. The previous owner is no longer an active writer on these paths.

Review all BA-01 to BA-21 dispositions against their owning issues. Applicable V1 corrections/disclosures require evidence; V2 and deferred items require an explicit scope decision and visible limitations where relevant. No known misleading conclusion may pass solely because it matches the source.
Verify hostile imported content and original-preview isolation across the completed viewer. Report the 42-view parity result separately from production-only/deferred capabilities.

Verify the audit findings that docs/reference/audit-dispositions.md assigns to this gate. Check non-overlapping headings and export controls at narrow widths for every view with page actions (BA-12), shared contrast and focus, hover and active states (BA-13), navigation semantics, focus and Back across all 42 views (BA-14), and risk and detail readability at 320 and 390 pixels (BA-21).
Verify a backup-and-restore round trip for each store named in CC-10's coverage checklist, once its owning ticket has passed.

Every v5 source defect in docs/reference/defects.md has a disposition in the parity register. Defects in imported data are never silently corrected in the app; they are tagged data-correction-deferred-to-pipeline for the document-processing pipeline sprint.

List optional/unsupported outputs explicitly. A single edited risk record or a prebuilt sample package does not prove this handoff.

items.title: Set up pstack and verification skills for agent CLI access
items.outcome: A newly started implementation or review agent can use the project-approved pstack and verification skills through a reproducible, non-interactive CLI, with real exit codes and evidence files. This is the setup prerequisite for the local baseline; it does not implement the application.
scopeNotes: `AGENTS.md` changes are limited to tooling discovery and invocation instructions.
The coordinator-owned planning files and `scripts/planning/**` change only for the Linear synchronization step.
Project-scoped or ignored local agent configuration; reserve any additional shared paths before changing them.
acceptance: Inspect the existing repository instructions and configured pstack/verification skill sources. Record the exact source, version or revision, license/access requirements, supported runtimes and intended commands. Do not install an unrelated package merely because it is named pstack; unresolved source/access details are a HOLD.

Install or link the approved pstack and required verification skills in the actual execution environment. Document reproducible bootstrap, upgrade and removal steps. Keep credentials and machine-specific paths outside tracked configuration.

Expose documented CLI entry points for plan validation and each available verification capability. Agents must be able to discover and invoke them from a fresh non-interactive shell and an isolated worktree, without a GUI or an inherited interactive-shell profile. Document supported OS/shell combinations and fail unsupported environments clearly.

Provide a preflight/doctor command that checks runtime versions, tool/skill discovery, writable evidence paths and required browser/test dependencies where applicable. Missing dependencies must produce actionable errors and a nonzero exit code.

Use the actual tool commands and supported flags discovered from source/help. Wrap them only as needed; preserve stdout, stderr and exit codes. Verification receipts include command, tool version, base/head revision, environment, result and artifact locations. A skipped check or missing tool cannot produce PASS.

Synchronize this Linear review into canonical `docs/plan/work-items.json`, regenerate ticket briefs and update the delivery/kickoff documents, including CC-27, [GRS-36](https://linear.app/vaper/issue/GRS-36/implement-hosted-identity-client-provisioning-and-durable-user-work) / CC-28 (hosted foundation), audit dispositions and native dependency changes. This Linear update does not imply those repository files are already synchronized.

Keep the application Bun/TypeScript/Vitest bootstrap owned by [GRS-10](https://linear.app/vaper/issue/GRS-10/validate-and-convert-a-portable-results-package). Tooling setup must not claim application tests passed before the application exists. Preserve original archives, production and private case material.
verification: Bootstrap from documented prerequisites in a clean shell; repeat setup without duplicate or conflicting installation.
Run the existing planning checker with `--require-linear-ids`, and run the approved pstack `check-plan.mjs` against `docs/delivery-plan.md` using its verified invocation.
Compare a fresh Linear dependency readback through the planning checker's supported `--linear-relations PATH` input; local ID checks alone do not prove live graph agreement.
Run controlled valid and deliberately invalid plan fixtures. Confirm success/failure exit codes and useful diagnostics.
Invoke an available verification skill through the CLI against a small synthetic fixture; exercise both success and deliberate failure, and inspect its evidence outputs.
Repeat discovery and invocation in a newly created agent/worktree environment. Confirm a missing dependency and a skipped check cannot be reported as success.

An independent reviewer reruns the critical smoke checks at the exact reviewed revision. Record PASS, HOLD or FAIL with evidence before releasing [GRS-9](https://linear.app/vaper/issue/GRS-9/freeze-the-v5-fixture-and-behavior-baseline).
items.handoff: Use the existing project agent/model policy. Only the coordinator updates Linear and releases dependent work. Do not expose private case material to external services, change production, or embed secrets. Return changed paths, setup commands, pinned sources/versions, tested environments, evidence and unresolved prerequisites. No application implementation or deployment is authorized by completion of this setup ticket.

items.title: Implement hosted identity, client provisioning and durable user work
items.outcome: The approved hosted design is implemented: an operator can provision an isolated client and case, users can authenticate with the approved permissions, and case user work persists independently of published results. Client intake has a working foundation.
scopeNotes: Coordinator reserves shared server hooks, deployment/configuration and public information routes before implementation
acceptance: Implement the client boundary, provisioning/case creation, identity provider, sessions and admin/client/publisher permissions approved in [GRS-26](https://linear.app/vaper/issue/GRS-26/resolve-client-isolation-roles-and-cloudflare-deployment) and [GRS-27](https://linear.app/vaper/issue/GRS-27/gate-the-hosted-design-before-client-intake-implementation). Product choices remain in the design decision; do not silently invent client editing rights.
Enforce authorization server-side for case metadata, user-work reads/writes and assets. Deny unauthenticated, wrong-client, wrong-case and expired/revoked-session access.

Implement durable user-work storage scoped by client, case and stable document identity, separately from immutable results. Define schema upgrades, concurrent-edit conflict handling and restart recovery.

Test replacement publication and rollback against stable identities. Reused legacy refs must not move annotations to another document; ambiguous, changed or removed targets need an explicit unresolved state. Reject stale writes rather than silently losing edits.

Implement the foundation's backup/restore primitives and exercise them with synthetic data. End-to-end recovery remains verified by [GRS-32](https://linear.app/vaper/issue/GRS-32/verify-hosted-isolation-recovery-and-release-readiness).

Handle interrupted sign-in/session establishment with usable retry guidance (BA-19). Provide logged-out support and reviewed information-handling entry points before hosted release (BA-20); obtain approved content through the design owner.

Transfer `src/lib/storage/cloud/**` to [GRS-28](https://linear.app/vaper/issue/GRS-28/submit-and-resume-client-document-uploads) only after this ticket is accepted; the previous owner stops writing there. The coordinator serializes later shared adapter changes.
verification: Provision two synthetic clients and cases; verify the full approved role matrix using both UI and direct requests.
Verify login, session expiry/revocation and interrupted session establishment, with explicit recovery guidance.
Save user work, restart the process, restore from backup and verify tenant/case isolation.
Exercise concurrent edits, a reused document ref, a changed/removed original and publication rollback without data loss or silent reassignment.
Check logged-out support/information links without requiring account creation.

Record commands, exit codes, exact revision and evidence. An independent reviewer verifies the foundation before [GRS-28](https://linear.app/vaper/issue/GRS-28/submit-and-resume-client-document-uploads) begins. Use the staging budgets approved in [GRS-26](https://linear.app/vaper/issue/GRS-26/resolve-client-isolation-roles-and-cloudflare-deployment).
items.handoff: V2 work only; this ticket does not expand the local V1 kickoff. Use controlled data and a local/disposable staging environment. Preserve human publication approval and the existing project execution authority. No live notifications, public deployment or production changes under this planning update. Return changed paths, contracts, evidence and the explicit shared-path handoff.

items.title: Prove view-by-view parity with the v5 sample
items.outcome: An automated, offline parity harness shows, value by value, that each of the 42 views behaves like the v5 sample on the same input data, and produces a counts-only scorecard for stakeholders.
scopeNotes: `package.json` takes one `parity` script entry and is coordinator-serialized
acceptance: Render v5 (sandboxed headless Chromium, no network, fixed clock, read-only fixture) and the app (Bun production build, same clock) on the same data; extract normalized tables, KPIs, lists, text blocks, counts and the action inventory per view.
Interaction sweeps cover filter/sort combinations, register edit sequences on synthetic seeded user work, and parsed export content (CSV, DOCX, PDF, print).
v5-side adapters for all 42 views; app-side adapters for the pilot's overview and chronology; M2 owners add theirs.

An intentional-differences register (schema-validated, no case values) typed `improvement`, `defect-fix`, `data-correction-deferred-to-pipeline`, `not-yet-implemented` or `known-gap`, each approved by someone other than its author. Genuine improvements are registered and never fail; only unregistered differences fail.
As mutation proof, a planted regression in each category (filter/sort, calculation, register CRUD, export, navigation/focus, rendered text) is caught.
Case-bearing diffs stay local; only harness code, synthetic tests, the register and counts-only scorecards are committed.
liveScenarios: Render v5 and the app offline on the same fixture with the same fixed clock
Extract and compare the overview and chronology value by value
Run the v5-side adapters for all 42 views
Sweep filter and sort combinations on a pilot view
Replay a register edit sequence on synthetic seeded user work
Compare parsed CSV, DOCX, PDF and print export content
Pass a registered improvement without a failure
Fail an unregistered difference
Catch a planted regression in each of the six categories
Confirm the committed register and scorecard carry counts only, with no case values
items.performanceMetric: Wall time and peak memory of a full 42-view parity run
items.performanceBudget: Record the first full-run baseline on the accepted fixture; fail a regression above 1.25 times the median.
